layout.$description: Tokens for the layout primitives (PageContainer, Stack, Grid, Section): the only way screens set width, gaps and columns, so layout stays on the 4px grid and AcmeCo's own layout values. Decision 34.

gallery-max-width.$description: OBSERVED: AcmeCo's gallery results are two cards about 506px wide with a 20px gap, about 1,032px in all, centred (a reference screenshot at a 1,524px window, 2026-10-11): 1,064px with the 16px gutters either side. PageContainer width="gallery" (decision 45).

gap.$description: Named steps of the 4px spacing scale for Stack and Grid gaps. PROPOSED names; values from space.* (decision 5).

2xs.$description: PROPOSED: 4px, e.g. an icon beside its label.

xs.$description: PROPOSED: 8px, e.g. a pair of fields.

sm.$description: PROPOSED: 12px, e.g. items in a card.

md.$description: PROPOSED: 16px, the default; AcmeCo's most used padding (15px, 4,332 elements).

lg.$description: PROPOSED: 24px, e.g. cards in a list.

xl.$description: PROPOSED: 32px, e.g. columns of a page.

block.$description: LEGACY-NAMED: --legacy-block-gap, clamp(40px, 5vw, 72px): between blocks inside a section.

section.$description: LEGACY-NAMED: --legacy-section-gap, clamp(48px, 8vw, 96px): between the sections of a page.

main-width.$description: OBSERVED: AcmeCo's results column is 670px wide at 1440px, with the map taking the rest (audit capture and live site, 2026-10-10). SplitView's list column (decision 40).

main-padding.$description: PROPOSED: 16px around the list column's content, the page gutter.

aside-height-compact.$description: PROPOSED: below 1024px the aside (the map) is a 240px band above the list.

aside-height-top.$description: PROPOSED, BENCHMARK-INFORMED: with the map on top (decision 45), a 360px band above the results that stays in view while the cards scroll beneath it, about the benchmark's horizontal layout.

main-background.$description: OBSERVED: AcmeCo's map-view list column is light grey (#f3f3f3) behind white cards, its title and Sort sitting on the grey (a reference screenshot, 2026-10-11; decision 45).

bar-height.$description: OBSERVED: AcmeCo's phone listing keeps Call and Message in a bar about 72px tall fixed to the bottom (a phone recording, 2026-10-11): 48px buttons with 12px above and below.

bar-padding.$description: OBSERVED: about 12px above and below the buttons.

color.$description: OBSERVED: AcmeCo's thin grey lines (around the phone results title, between Save and Map).

height.$description: PROPOSED: a vertical divider 24px tall, a line of text's height ("Save | Map").

width.$description: OBSERVED: the property detail page's contact sidebar is 340px wide (audit capture; ContactModule, decision 30). Grid's main + aside template uses it.

color-subtle.$description: OBSERVED: AcmeCo's grey results bar ("157 Results" and Sort) under the gallery's filter bar is #f3f3f3 (a reference screenshot, 2026-10-11; decision 45).

color-default.$description: OBSERVED: the gallery's title band and filter bar are white, each with a thin grey line below.
